name: Visions hastes the party and buffs only the caster's own Shadow damage natively (#1016)
contract: Visions 560526 (Spell.dbc, read for this scenario) is a passive with two effects, both targeting the caster. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) carrying aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 2 DieSides 1 (+3), radius index 287 (100 yd), MaxAffectedTargets 0 (unlimited, so no truncation risk of the kind seen in other Ascension raid auras) -- matches 'Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%'. SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID is a stock area-aura effect type (Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura, SpellEffects.cpp:137) whose native target selection gathers the caster's raid/group within radius; aura 216 (AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed) is a stock cast-speed aura. Effect 1 is a plain SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA (not an area-aura type) carrying aura 79 MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, EffectMiscValue 32 (Shadow), BasePoints 2 DieSides 1 (+3), target caster only -- matches 'in addition, your Shadow damage is increased by 3%' (self only, as the tooltip literally reads). No script is needed; grep confirms zero occurrences of 560526 in src/server/coa or src/server/game, matching only that absence. The harness spawns all fixtures at the same shared location, so range is not independently tested here; the party member is the positive control and the ungrouped bystander (same distance, same aura, just not grouped) is the negative control on SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID's group-membership requirement, mirroring venomancer-fungal-link-party-haste-rot.json's proven pattern for the same effect type.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Party the cultist and the mate; the outsider stays ungrouped
Baseline cast speed of the cultist
Baseline cast speed of the party member
Baseline cast speed of the outsider
Baseline Shadow damage bonus of the party member (no aura on them)
The cultist carries Visions with +3 spell haste on effect 0
The party member receives the raid-wide aura from the cultist
CONTROL: the ungrouped bystander does not carry the raid aura
The cultist's cast time shrinks by 3%
The party member's cast time shrinks by 3%
CONTROL: the bystander's cast speed is unchanged
CONTRACT: the cultist's own Shadow damage bonus rises by exactly 3%
CONTROL: effect 1 does not propagate -- the party member's Shadow damage is unchanged
Unlearning removes the raid aura from the party member
The party member's cast speed returns to baseline
